description: Deterministic FactLot ID for a parcel from state FIPS, county FIPS, and the assessor's parcel number (APN). The same parcel always yields the same ID, offline. Use it as the join key across systems. APNs that differ only in where a separator falls ("12-34", "1-234") get different IDs; in a county with a documented fixed-width format the variants of one APN converge (NYC BBL "3-1234-56" = "3012340056").

apn.description: Assessor's parcel number exactly as the county prints it. Letter case and the separator characters are normalized; where a separator falls is kept, except in counties with a documented fixed-width format (NYC BBL, Los Angeles AIN, Cook County PIN, DC SSL).

county_fips.description: 3-digit county FIPS code, e.g. "037" for Los Angeles County.

state_fips.description: 2-digit state FIPS code, e.g. "06" for California.
